title: How to Use
subtitle: Everything about finding, buying, and downloading sheet music, plus the perks worth knowing.

quickStart.title: Your first purchase in 3 steps
quickStart.note: No sign-up needed — you can buy with just your email.

find.title: Find a sheet
find.detail: Search by song title or artist, or browse by genre.

pay.title: Pay
pay.detail: Buy right away, or add several songs to your cart and pay at once.

download.title: Download the PDF
download.detail: Right after payment, download the PDF from Purchase History.

search.title: Find the sheet you want
points: Type the song title together with the artist for more accurate results. Spacing and brackets don't matter.
Filter by genre, difficulty, and price on the catalog page.
Check the preview images and performance video on the sheet page to make sure it's the version you want.
Can't find a song? Request a custom order — when you come from a search with no results, the title is filled in for you.

payment.title: Paying
points: You can pay by credit/debit card or PayPal, and also use your Credits and Rewards.
Add several songs to your cart to pay for them all at once.
Buying without signing up creates an account for you. Set a password from the email we send to sign in again anytime.

download.title: Downloading
points: You can download your sheets again anytime from Purchase History, which also appears as a tab in My Page.
Files are high-quality PDFs you can view on a phone or tablet or print. Please use them for personal practice only.
Pre-order sheets are transcribed after payment and appear in Purchase History when finished. Until then, the expected completion date is shown.
If downloads don't work inside an app like Instagram, open the site in a regular browser such as Chrome or Safari.

benefits.title: Get more from Credits and Rewards
points: Add Credits in advance and get bonus Credits depending on the amount — up to 25%.
Earn 3–7% of the amount you pay as Rewards on every purchase, depending on your membership tier.
Use Rewards at checkout. They stay valid for 1 year from the day you earn them.
The Flash Sale corner offers limited-time discounts. Prices go back to normal when the timer ends.

customOrder.title: Custom Order
customOrder.detail: Our professionals transcribe songs that aren't on the site. We send a quote after listening, and it usually takes 1–3 days after payment.

myBook.title: My Drum Book
myBook.detail: Pick songs and get a single PDF book with a cover and table of contents. The more you add, the bigger the discount.

freeLessons.title: Free Lessons
freeLessons.detail: Watch lesson videos and sheets for grooves and fills you can practice right away — for free.

help.title: Still have questions?
help.description: Check the FAQ first, and if you still need help, ask us anytime via chat.
